- Expected scale: pilot ~100k monthly requests, production target ~2M monthly tokens.
- Decision timeline: target procurement decision within 6-8 weeks.

Stakeholders you mentioned we should engage:
- Economic buyer: Priya Shah (CFO) - procurement/contract lead.
- Security/compliance SME: Jordan Lee (Infosec lead).
- Legal/procurement: TBD (please confirm point person and vendor intake URL).

1) Can you confirm the procurement path (vendor portal, PO, legal redlines) and who owns it on your side?
2) For security intake, please confirm systems in scope (app backend, data stores, analytics, logs, SSO).
3) I\u2019ve attached our standard security questionnaire (Redwood-Security-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx) - would you prefer we fill any fields first, or would you like Medora to complete it?
4) Proposed: schedule a 30-45 min security kickoff next week to walk the questionnaire and evidence list. Available windows: Tue 7/20 10-12 PT or Wed 7/21 9-11 PT.

Attachments: Redwood-Security-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) - also uploaded to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-medora-security

If you want, I can loop in our legal contact (logan_wright) and our security engineer (rishi_malhotra) on the kickoff.

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Best,

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. A few answers and requested clarifications below.

Procurement / buying process:
- Economic/Procurement owner: Priya Shah (CFO). She handles vendor approval and PO.
- Typical timeline: internal review + security intake ~2 weeks, procurement & legal review 4-6 weeks - so your 6-8 week target aligns.
- Vendor intake: we use a vendor portal - I will share the registration link and required fields.

Systems in scope for security review (initial):
- Medora web application (user-facing UI) - hosted on AWS (ECS/Fargate)
- Public & internal API endpoints (API Gateway + ALB)
- Data stores: RDS for transactional data, Redshift for analytics
- Object storage: S3 buckets (logs and attachments)
- Auth: Okta SSO; audit logs forwarded to Splunk

Required artifacts for intake (please confirm you can supply):
- Completed security questionnaire (the one you attached)
- SOC 2 report (if available) or SSP summary
- Network diagram + data flow for systems in scope
- Encryption at rest/in transit statement and key management details

Attachments: I\u2019ve attached a short POV doc that lists our initial concerns and evidence requests (Medora_Security_POC.pdf). I\u2019ll also share the vendor portal link and the security questionnaire template they prefer.

Preferred kickoff time: Wed 7/21 09:30 PT works for me. If that's good for Priya and your team, lock it in.

Jordan Lee
Head of InfoSec | Medora Health
jordan.lee@medora-health.com
